description_ru: Личный взгляд владельца пса Макса: почему собака двигает нас, дружит с нами и помогает знакомиться.
text:
I think dogs make our lives better. I know that many people love cats, and my sister is one of them. She says, "Cats are clean, quiet and independent." That is true. But I have a dog called Max, and I cannot imagine my life without him. After five years with Max, I am sure that a dog is the best pet for most people. Here is my opinion.

Max is a big brown dog with soft ears and a very long tail. Every morning he wakes me up at seven o'clock. He puts his nose on my hand, and he looks at me with his big eyes. I say, "Five more minutes!" but he never agrees. At first this made me angry. Now I think it is a gift, because he gets me out of bed and into the fresh air. Without Max, I think I would sleep until noon.

The first reason I love dogs is that they make us move. Max needs a long walk twice a day, in rain, snow or sun. Because of him I walk about two hours every day. I know all the parks in my town. I have better health, and I feel younger than before. My neighbour has a cat, and she says that she never goes outside in winter. I am never inside for long, because Max is waiting at the door.

The second reason is friendship. A dog is always happy to see you. When I come home from work, Max runs to the door. His tail goes left and right, and he jumps around me. It does not matter if I had a bad day or if I forgot his dinner. He is just glad that I am home. When I feel sad, he sits next to me and puts his head on my knee. I do not need words. He understands me.

The third reason is that dogs help us meet people. In the park everybody knows Max, and they know me as "Max's owner". I talk to other dog owners every day. We talk about food, training and the weather. I have made five new friends in this way. One of them is an old lady with a small white dog, and she brings me cookies at Christmas. If I had no dog, I would not know her at all.

Dogs are also clever and can learn a lot. Max knows twelve words. He can sit, lie down, give me his paw and bring me my shoes. Last winter he found my lost glove in the snow. Some dogs help blind people to cross the street, and some help doctors in hospitals. Dogs even work for the police and find lost people in the mountains. I think this is amazing. Which cat can do that? My sister laughs and says that her cat is too clever to work for people. Maybe she is right, but I still prefer my hard-working friend.

Of course, I know that dogs are not easy. They need time, money and a lot of love. A dog cannot stay alone all day. Max eats a lot, and the doctor for animals is expensive. He also makes mud on my floor and sometimes eats my socks. Once he ate a whole cake from the table when I was in the kitchen. I was very angry, but he looked so sorry that I laughed. If you work twelve hours a day, a dog is probably not right for you.

My advice to people who want a dog is simple. Think carefully before you choose. Ask yourself if you can walk him every day, in all weather. Visit a shelter, because many good dogs there need a home. Max came from a shelter, and he was thin and afraid. Now he is strong and happy, and he is the best friend I have. I believe that I saved him, but he saved me too.

So, are dogs better than cats? For me, the answer is yes. But if you love your cat, that is fine too. The most important thing is to love your animal and take care of it. Every pet is a friend. Still, when I come home, tired and cold, and a big brown dog jumps on me with joy, I think, "This is the best feeling in the world."

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Спинка языка к нёбу, звук идёт через нос; не добавляйте «г» в конце.
Скольжение от «э» к «и»; не обрывайте на «э».
«L» в конце слога твёрже и глубже русского «ль», кончик языка у дёсен.

questions.question: What is the name of the writer's dog?
How does Max wake the writer up?
questions.answer: He puts his nose on the writer's hand and looks at him at seven o'clock.

questions.question: What can dogs do for people?
questions.answer: They help blind people, help doctors and find lost people in the mountains.
